infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Burnout uses your location to show nearby meets and share your position with meet attendees.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Burnout uses your location in the background to share your position during meets.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Burnout uses your camera to take photos for posts and your garage.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Burnout accesses your photos to post images and add vehicle photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Burnout uses your location to show nearby meets and share your position with meet attendees.

plugins.cameraPermission: Burnout uses your camera to take photos.
